goals.label: Keep catch rate at or above baseline (87%)
Sneaky rogue: catch at least as often as baseline (68%)
Held-back rogues: catch at least as often as baseline
Note reading checked on real Among Us logs
goals.note: Hugging Face and the Claude API are unreachable from the build machine

steps.finding: Organizer baseline: both disputants get a strike, out at two.
steps.change: Reproduced exactly (177/200, 1.38 false q/game, ledger 285) and froze it.

steps.finding: 60% of baseline false quarantines happen after the rogue is already out; bystanders pay the same as culprits.
steps.change: One probability over five suspects, agreements clear, retrial before quarantine, direction of errors, stand-down after a catch.

steps.finding: 92% of damage comes from rounds where the rogue lied; catching it cannot undo the lie.
steps.change: Repair: when a retrial gives a 2-of-3 majority, the ledger takes the majority.

steps.finding: Our rogues might be too easy to beat if we tune on them.
steps.change: Added two held-back rogues nobody tunes on: late big strikes and framer.

steps.finding: Misses: 16 starter rogues lied 2+ times and escaped; sneaky damage sits in rounds 9-12; sneaky false quarantines all before the catch (framing).
steps.change: Testing five fixes: error size, anti-framing second retrial, recency weighting, check before deciding, trust-weighted ledger.
